# Mesh and scene fixtures

Authored examples are generated by `examples/fixtures/mesh_scene.rs` and are MIT licensed with Catwalk. Binary files use their native encoding: STL, PLY, MDL, 3DS, GLB, USDC, USDZ and Alembic Ogawa.

`draco-google-cube.drc` and compressed glTF/GLB copies retain Google's Apache-2.0 cube_att.obj.edgebreaker.cl4.2.2.drc testdata, from https://github.com/google/draco/tree/main/testdata. The original license is `GOOGLE-DRACO-LICENSE`. All resources remain inside this directory; regeneration uses no network, external executables or native codecs.
